_note: DRAFT HYPOTHESES written as a starting point, NOT sourced facts. Every rating (0-3) and note must be reviewed by Aleena (packaging science) and linked to a collected source before the demo. evidenceStatus stays 'draft' until then and drives the confidence label in the report.

options.name: Remove the outer carton
options.summary: Drop secondary packaging where the bottle can be sold and shipped without it.
extraGaps: Transit damage and retailer shelf requirements not assessed.
nextSteps: Run a small transit-damage trial without the carton.

options.name: Replace full-body shrink sleeve with a compatible label or direct print
options.summary: Reduce material and remove a component that can interfere with sorting/recycling.
extraGaps: Label adhesive and ink compatibility with the bottle recycling stream not verified.
nextSteps: Ask the label supplier for a recyclability-tested label/adhesive spec.
Check brand/legal text still fits the smaller label area.

options.name: Switch to a mono-material pump (no metal spring)
options.summary: Remove mixed-material parts from the closure/dispenser.
extraGaps: Dispensing performance and supplier MOQ not verified.
nextSteps: Request mono-material pump samples and test dosing/viscosity fit.

options.name: Use post-consumer recycled (PCR) resin in the existing bottle
options.summary: Keep the bottle format, raise recycled content.

compatWarnings.text: Fragranced products: PCR odour and stress-cracking behaviour need testing.

extraGaps: Cosmetic-suitable PCR grade availability and recycled-content proof not verified.
nextSteps: Ask the bottle supplier for PCR grades and recycled-content documentation.
Run compatibility / stability testing on PCR samples.

options.name: Offer a flexible refill pouch alongside a reusable bottle
options.summary: Largest potential material reduction per use, but flexible packaging has weaker recycling evidence.

compatWarnings.text: Fragrance/oil permeation through pouch film needs verification.

extraGaps: EU recycling route for the specific pouch structure unverified.
Consumer refill behaviour and hygiene not assessed.
nextSteps: Get pouch structure and recyclability data from the supplier.

options.name: Switch to an aluminium bottle
options.summary: Strong metal-recycling story, but compatibility with the formulation needs checking.

compatWarnings.text: Low-pH formulation: corrosion risk, internal lining and lab compatibility testing required.
Surfactant/salt systems can corrode unlined aluminium: confirm lining spec with the supplier.

extraGaps: Lining material recyclability and compatibility are unverified.
nextSteps: Request lined-aluminium specs and run compatibility testing before any commitment.

options.name: Switch to a glass bottle
options.summary: Good recyclability and inertness, with weight, transport and breakage trade-offs.
extraGaps: Breakage risk in wet bathroom use not assessed.
nextSteps: Quantify added weight per unit and shipping cost.
Review consumer-safety implications of glass in bathrooms.

options.name: Reformulate as a solid shampoo bar
options.summary: Avoids bottles entirely, but needs a new formulation.

options.name: Switch to a PLA bioplastic bottle
options.summary: Bio-based, but end-of-life routes for rigid PLA bottles are unclear.
options.knownUnsuitable: Insufficient evidence to confirm a mainstream EU collection/recycling route for rigid PLA bottles; validation required before commitment.
